_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Snapshot compiled 2026-09-26 from individual CDPP sentencing entries and a Royal Commission operations exhibit. The CDPP 2015 list is a historical legal snapshot; later appeal outcomes are cited where checked. Roles and drugs follow individual exhibit categories; money-laundering or precursor defendants are not assumed to have trafficked MDMA. Australia is a source-backed historical operating association, not a live location. No inferred personal edges, unlicensed portraits, operational routes, or enforcement gaps.
